# Chitinid
An industrious hymenoptera species, the Chitinid are strong and diligent. Thanks to evolution, they have grown an acute resistance to radiation, but not without its side effects.
## Diet - Can eat raw meat.
## Benefits - Takes 80% less Radiation, 10% less Slash Blunt and Piercing. - Their bodies naturally recover from light radiation damage up to a point, once they accumulate enough radiation they must purge it from their systems in the form of a small rock [color=#ff0f0f]WARNING:The Chitzite they expel is slightly radioactive [/color]. - They possess a bio light.
## Drawbacks - They take 15% more Shock damage due to their biology. - Due to their hard shells normal syringes can not pierce them, requiring hypos to bypass the toughness. - Thanks to their overactive systems they get hungry 33% faster. - The cold does not agree with their biology and makes their movement sluggish the colder it gets, the cold also harms them more than others causing them to take 25% more damage from it. - Bug Blood.
## Chitinid Naming Conventions
Chitinid use a naming scheme which often incorporates the combination of two syllables with an apostrophe to seperate them. They typically do not have last names. ## Lore
The Chitinid species originate from a world where nuclear disasters had left the planet inhospitable to most life. This upbringing would develop a culture for most Chitinids that would both focus on the importance of practical survival skills alongside a demeanor that while apocalypse scenarios are indeed dangerous they aren't an end. They are a beginning.
